messages:
Lena H: heads up - 09:03 deploy to promptx-mux-v2 started and we're seeing a rising tail-latency and 504 spikes on requests routed to the experimental worker pool. not all customers, but a handful of high-traffic tenants.
Ethan M: looking at traces - the new mux path spawns extra concurrent KV warmups when multi-turn prompts hit the cache miss. p99 latency jumping from 220ms -> 1.8s.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T09:02:41Z by lena-h completed. canary traffic set to 25%.
Samantha K (support): two customers (org-Delta, org-Sierra) opened live tickets complaining about stalled replies. marking P1 until we confirm impact.
Rob T (oncall): I'm paged. joining. Lena, can you trip the feature flag kill-switch for promptx? Need to stop canary traffic while we triage.
Lena H: attempting kill via CLI: `redwood-ff set promptx_routing disabled --env=prod --reason "emergency-kill-latency-2026-03-15"`
ops-bot: Feature flag promptx_routing set to disabled by lena-h at 2026-03-15T09:08:12Z.
incident-bot: Auto-detect: feature flag change for promptx_routing. Event logged.
Ethan M: immediately after flag flip, 504s drop to baseline; p95 back to ~320ms. looks like gating worked.
Rob T (oncall): good. keep it off. I want a quick rollback of the canary deploy too so we don't get residual traffic routing oddities. Lena, can you trigger canary abort?
Lena H: aborting canary -> scaling down canary ASG from 8 -> 0 and removing routing weights. running: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name promptx-canary --desired-capacity 0`
ops-bot: Autoscaling action initiated for promptx-canary. Desired capacity -> 0.
QA-bot: test harness executed smoke checks against stable route. sample prompts returned in <400ms.
Samantha K (support): updating status page: "Investigating elevated latency affecting some prompt responses. Canary halted and feature flag disabled. Engineers investigating root cause." link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3339990001
Ethan M: debug notes - new mux code path uses an unbounded goroutine pool that schedules concurrent prefetches; combined with certain prompt shapes it can saturate network backpressure and produce queued requests that eventually time out with 504s.
Rob T (oncall): assign incident owner for RCA and mitigation plan. Severity judgement? partial customer impact but no full outage. SEV3?
Lena H: I can own the RCA with Ethan. set severity SEV3.
incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV3. Owner: Lena H.
Ethan M: I'll open a hotfix branch to add a configurable concurrency cap and backpressure signals. Also add timeout/fail-fast on prefetch. PR will include unit + integration tests.
Lena H: we should also add an automated canary safety that flips the flag automatically if >3% errors or >500ms p95 for 5m. file ticket for optimize canary-safety.
Samantha K (support): coordinating customer comms: draft to affected customers: "We've temporarily disabled experimental prompt routing following elevated latency during a canary. Mitigation applied; engineers are investigating root cause and will follow up with RCA." will post in the next 10 mins.
Rob T (oncall): let's monitor for 30 minutes then regroup. If any regression after re-enablement, we rollback the full deploy and notify impacted customers.
Lena H: collecting flamegraphs and goroutine dumps from canary nodes before they terminate. saving to: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3339990001/
Ethan M: found reproducer script for the prompt shape. uploading to repo: https://git.internal/r/redwood/transformer/+/2389. Running staging canary with concurrency cap shows no regressions.
QA-bot: staging run: canary-sim test passed (1000 requests, p95 260ms).
Samantha K (support): posting interim update: "Mitigation applied (experimental route disabled). We're confirming fix in staging; we'll provide an ETA for re-enabling after validation."
Rob T (oncall): good work. handoff to Lena/Ethan for full fix and RCA. I'll stay reachable in case of customer escalations.
incident-bot: Incident moved to monitoring at 09:17. Last observed error spike subsided.
Lena H: creating postmortem ticket and assigning to me + Ethan. will include timeline, impact, triage steps, and action items: cap concurrency, add canary autosafety, improve monitoring alerts.
Samantha K (support): will prepare customer-facing RCA after postmortem.
Ethan M: pushing hotfix candidate to main for review. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/transformer/+/2391
Rob T (oncall): thanks team. closing the active page; reopen if we see any recurrence.
Samantha K (support): closing support tickets as "mitigated - monitoring" and will reopen if customers report further issues. :thumbsup:
Lena H: marking mitigation complete at 09:20 and will track follow-ups in the postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident resolved to monitoring at 09:20. Severity SEV3.
